 Order

This Writ Petition has been filed for a Certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records in connection with order made in Na.Ka.No.23766/2022/Y8 dated 31.10.2022 passed by the 3rd Respondent and quash the same as illegal and void and consequently directing the respondents to refer the matter to the competent civil court for the determination of the higher compensation under Section 18(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 in so far as the acquired land of the petitioner's property in Survey No.285/2, to an extent of 0.74.5 Hectors (1.84 Acres) situated in B.Thatampatti Village,
Pappireddipatti Taluk, Dharmapuri District.
2.
When the matter was taken up for hearing the learned Additional ____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

Government Pleader for the Respondents has produced a communication dated 07.12.2024 and submitted that Section 18(1) Reference has been filed on 07.12.2024 on the file of Principle Subordinate Judge, Dharmapuri in LAOP  ATN20240011665C202400007 and therefore, the relief claimed by the Petitioner has been granted.
3.
Recording the above submission, the Writ Petition stands allowed.
